<!-- pr-reviewer: def6bd8db7bce8b51f48a941ee5aa40aa7b5acef -->
**Needs changes before merge** - one process blocker (the `PROCESS_VERSION` number); the code itself looks right.

### What looks good
- One law, one command: the tool runs `pick::align_roles` unchanged and places the frame through `SetWcsOrigin::new` + `history.execute`, with rotation from `quat_from_euler(roll, pitch, yaw)` of the law's angles. That is exactly the GUI Apply path (`crates/ui/src/state.rs:3011-3022`, `wcs_pick_row.rs:107`). No second frame derivation, no new command kind, one undo step; `setup::wcs_slot` / `wcs_entity` are used only to read the result back (`wcs_tools.rs:108-121`).
- Picks use the shared id parse, `req_model`, and `check_pickable` (the one-pick rule), so stale ids and non-feature picks are refused before anything runs (`wcs_tools.rs:56-67`). Refusals (missing/short/duplicate picks, <2 axes, vertex as axis, edge as origin, parallel axes, bad role, unknown model, extra keys, inactive `setup`) are plain-English and the WCS stays unplaced.
- No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic!` in the new code; non-finite angles are refused (`wcs_tools.rs:78`). New module has its provenance line and is 147 lines.
- Tool is in the table (`tools.rs`, `mod.rs`); skill row, workflow diagram and shipped/gaps lines updated; `Changelog:` line and decision note present; body ends `Fixes #937`.
- Probe on a 40x40x15 box (from `mcp_wcs_features`): plain 3-2-1 gives origin (-20,-20,15) with identity axes; Z = +X side face, Y = its top edge, origin vertex (20,-20,15) gives z=(1,0,0), y=(0,1,0), x=(0,0,-1) (= Y x Z, right-handed); Z top face + X edge + bore wall patch as origin gives origin (0,0,15). The placed origin and rotation equal the law + GUI quaternion bit for bit.

### Local results (PR head merged with current main; clean merge, no conflicts)
| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --no-run` | ok |
| `mcp_wcs_features` | 2 passed |
| `mcp` | 18 passed |
| `mcp_pick` | 6 passed |
| `wcs_roles` | 9 passed |
| `wcs_align` / `one_wcs` / `rotated_wcs` / `setup_wcs` | 5 / 8 / 9 / 7 passed |
| `camcraft-app --lib` | 147 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

UI suites not run (no UI file changed).

### Requested before merge
1. `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION:1` - it is 31, and main is already at 31 (another process PR landed it). The PR changes `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md`, a process file, so it must end above main's value: take the next number, **32** (and update the "PROCESS_VERSION 31" text in the PR body / #681 entry to match).

### Notes (not blocking)
- Toolpath staleness after the WCS moves is whatever `SetWcsOrigin` does; this tool shares that path with the GUI and adds nothing of its own, so behaviour is the same as clicking Apply.
- The `setup` argument must be the active setup (refused otherwise, same as the GUI greying Apply). Fine, and the error says to `activate_setup` first.
- This is a `feat`: it merges at the next cut.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
